items.title: File Clay County business personal property return
items.description: Missouri personal property assessment lists are due to the county assessor by March 1 (the next business day if it falls on a weekend).

items.title: File Greene County business personal property return
items.description: Missouri personal property assessment lists are due to the county assessor by March 1 (the next business day if it falls on a weekend).

items.title: File Jackson County business personal property return
items.description: Missouri businesses declare taxable tangible personal property (machinery, equipment, furniture, fixtures) owned on January 1 to the county assessor by March 1; a late-filing penalty is added to the tax bill and may be waived if the list arrives by May 1 (RSMo 137.115, 137.345). File through the county E-File Portal; late filers can owe $15 to $105 depending on assessed value.

The assessor says lists must be returned by March 1 to avoid late penalties.

items.title: File City of St. Louis business personal property return
items.description: The City of St. Louis Assessor takes personal property declarations online, by mail or in person by April 1 to avoid a 10% assessment penalty (the city's date differs from the March 1 used by Missouri counties). Corporate personal property: (314) 622-4181.
